sent_to_model:
need the yearly caravan email doing to our Jan, Pete and Carol. park bill for next year is in my inbox and theyve all emailed about weeks. last years is in sent. one email to all 3 not 3 seperate. just draft it ill look in the morning before work include the shares, pay date, weeks, shower and both reminders below.

- split 4 ways same as always, me Jan Pete Carol. works out £1,271.75 each
- money to me by 31 Jan, same account as before. park wants it all by then
- me and Bev 5-12 June 2027, handover 5 June
- Pete and Linda 29 May-5 June 2027
- two instalments if wanted, £635.87 in Dec and £635.88 in Jan
- Carol asked Easter and Sept, Jan wants 7th-14th Aug, Pete May half term. no clashes this year
- shower tray Pete mentioned, I went up 26 Oct and put a new one in, £140 parts. Im not putting it on the bill, its done
- its gone up again, near £350 on last year. nothing I can do about it, park sets it
- if anyone wants to pay in 2 lots thats fine, Dec and Jan. say it for everyone, dont single Pete out
- remind them stop tap off when they leave, park moaned again
- mention the survey thing for 2028 so nobodys surprised, van is 16 year old

(About me: plumber who runs a two-van business, 58, Leeds, England. Length: all the messages together should come to roughly 250-400 words.)

Thank you for having us round on Monday. As discussed the quote for the bathroom is below.

Total £2,450 inc materials. We can start the week of the 23rd if that suits, job should be four days.

Mick
